tour.viewerText: This section was generated from your sources. Read its evidence and confidence, and keep missing facts explicit. To resolve a gap, add evidence in Sources and update the BIO; you do not need to write it from scratch.
tour.sourceText: Add a public reference link or upload a brand document. An upload error appears beside this control. New evidence must be incorporated through Update BIO before requesting human review.
tour.label: Discovery guide
tour.brandText: Add your website, or use documents if there is no site. For a new brand, enter its name. You are supplying evidence, not writing the BIO yourself.
tour.referencesText: Add a link, choose current brand, desired direction or competitive context, then explain what matters: typography, photography, tone or positioning. Reference brands never become your current brand facts.
tour.filesText: Use foundations for brand documents, visual for design examples, and voice for writing samples. Choose current or desired direction. Files must be 15 MB or smaller; any upload problem appears beside the affected file.
tour.generateText: Select Generate BIO once your sources are ready. We upload files first and start discovery only after uploads succeed. Generation can take several minutes. You will review the result before confirming it.
tour.reviewText: Open each section to inspect the interpretation and its evidence. Correct mistakes or add a source for missing information. Unknown facts should stay unknown.
tour.chapterText: Review the generated values against your sources. Correct an interpretation only when you have evidence; leave gaps explicit. Use Mark accurate for supported facts and Mark aspirational for desired directions. Return to all chapters when finished.
tour.confirmTitle: Confirm only what you can support
tour.confirmText: Review the confirmation statements. Confirm the BIO only if you are authorized, it represents the brand, and desired directions are marked separately. You can save and return later.

greeting.home: *Briefing a new flow lives in the launchpad above.* Use this for status, advice, or anything you'd ask a CMO mid-week.
greeting.discovery: *You're mid-extraction.* I'm reading the site in another tab. Ask me anything while we wait — including 'what should I check first when it lands'.
greeting.bio: *The BIO is the canon.* I'll quote it back if you ask me about a field. Ask me what's weak.
greeting.briefs: *Three briefs in flight, four shipped.* Ask me about any one of them, or ask me which one I'd push first this week.
greeting.briefDetail: *You're inside a brief.* I can take you through the SMP, the refusals, or what I'd do differently if we were writing it tomorrow.
greeting.specialists: *That's your department.* Ask me who I'd assemble for a specific job, and I'll show you the pick + why.
greeting.canvas: *This is the workspace.* The map gets denser as you ship. Ask me about any node, or ask me what's downstream of the BIO.
greeting.craft: *Hand work the team should finish.* I'll match a finishing pack to a job if you describe it.
greeting.credits: *Spend, not budget.* Ask me where the money went, or what would change if you doubled the cycle.
greeting.settings: *Workspace governance.* Ask me what the forbidden list should be, or whether your auto-approve threshold is loose.
greeting.default: *I'm Brandolph.* Ask me what's running, what's stuck, or what to do next. Free to ask — briefs preview cost.
